subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should the Control UI persist and automatically restore per-Gateway, per-agent new-session workspace, worktree, model, and reasoning preferences in browser-local storage?
rationale: The branch adds a durable user-preference behavior that intentionally changes the default state of future drafts; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the product precedence and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve browser-local restoration
options.body: Accept the proposed per-Gateway and per-agent scope once connected-Gateway proof confirms that invalid stored values fall back safely.

options.title: Narrow the remembered fields
options.body: Keep only the subset of workspace, worktree, model, or reasoning choices that maintainers want to restore automatically.

options.title: Keep default-only drafts
options.body: Decline persistent restoration and retain the existing behavior of opening every new draft from current defaults.

recommendation.title: Approve browser-local restoration
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed per-Gateway and per-agent scope once connected-Gateway proof confirms that invalid stored values fall back safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history shows steipete carrying the submitted implementation and its validation refinements.
